raw:
The 2013 Belgian Grand Prix was won by Sebastian Vettel, driving for Red Bull. In the 2014 season, Red Bull won 3 races, all by Daniel Ricciardo:

1. Canadian Grand Prix (round 7)
2. Hungarian Grand Prix (round 11)
3. Belgian Grand Prix (round 12)

I checked the winner of each of the 19 races in the 2014 season and found no other Red Bull wins.

ANSWER: 3
